12259.d: The God Wars Dungeon (often abbreviated as GWD), originally known as the Temple of Lost Ancients, is a dangerous dungeon where armies of various gods, left over from the God Wars, fight one another to the death.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Prerequisites
• Navigating towards the dungeon requires having defeated Dad in the Troll Stronghold quest
• Entering the dungeon itself requires 60 Strength or 60 Agility 
• Entering each god encampment (therefore the boss rooms) has a skill requirement:
• Armadyl's Eyrie (south-west) - 70 Ranged 
• Bandos's Stronghold (north-west) - 70 Strength 
• Saradomin's Encampment (south-east) - 70 Agility 
• Zamorak's Fortress (north) - 70 Constitution 

Teleports
• Boss portal at War's Retreat - Requires killing any generals at least once and access to War's Retreat, and at least 100 total boss kills
• Combat portal at Max Guild - Requires Max Cape achievement and killing any generals at least once
• God Wars Dungeon Teleport - Requires level 61 Magic and completion of The Mighty Fall
• God wars teleport tablet - Requires completion of The Mighty Fall
• Trollheim Teleport - Standard spells, requires level 61 Magic and completion of Eadgar's Ruse
• Trollheim tablet - Requires completed Love Story and taken the miner's diary to the Wise Old Man
• Trollheim Farm Teleport - Lunar spells, requires level 92 Magic, completion of My Arm's Big Adventure, and unlock at Livid Farm rewards

Travelling from Fremennik Province
• Teleport to the entrance to Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, for example fairy ring AJR, ring of slaying, Fremennik Province lodestone.
• Equip climbing boots to climb the [[Rocks (Death Plateau)

Travelling from Burthorpe
• Teleport to Burthorpe lodestone.
• Equip climbing boots (obtain them from Freda if the player does not have them). Also requires 41 Agility for cliffside.
• Follow the route to get to the dungeon. This route may take damage from Thrower Trolls around [[Death Plateau (location)

gt.heading: Entrance
gt.text:
Entrance zone

Players must push the boulder (requires level 60 Strength, boosted) or squeeze past it (requires level 60 Agility, boosted) to enter the entrance zone.

Once past the boulder, an icy, cold area before the dungeon entrance is reached. This area will periodically drain the player's stats, run energy, adrenaline, prayer points, summoning points, and life points. If it drains the player's Agility or Strength level so that neither is above level 60, they will be prevented from going back through the boulder.

Walk north to find the dungeon entrance. There are several aggressive level 72 ice wolves near the entrance that attack with melee.

Make sure all god-related protection items are equipped. A mistake will most likely lead to a swift death.

The dying knight

Players can talk to the dying knight south-west of the dungeon entrance and receive the knight's notes. The knight asks the player to take the notes to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park. Players can enter the dungeon without bringing the notes to Sir Tiffy. Players don't even need the notes to enter, just speak to the knight before entering the first time. 

If the notes are taken to Sir Tiffy, he takes them whether they have been read or not.

After grabbing the notes from the dying knight, he succumbs to his fatal wounds. If the notes were not taken to Sir Tiffy (by destroying it), another set of notes can be obtained from his corpse.
